title: Turkey tikka peppers
summary: Turkey tikka peppers is a indian dinner built around turkey breast steaks and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Turkey tikka peppers into even pieces and toss red peppers with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of red peppers while you season turkey breast steaks. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle turkey breast steaks and red onions among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Turkey tikka peppers before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Turkey tikka peppers into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
